name: Wonik Holdings Co., Ltd
summary: Wonik Holdings Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company, established in P1991 and headquartered in Pyeongtaek, that manufactures and supplies a range of equipment for electronic and semiconductor applications, among other industries. Its comprehensive product line features essential systems such as gas supply, purification, and chamber systems, in addition to precursor delivery, gas piping, and sophisticated gas monitoring solutions. These specialized offerings are integral to manufacturing processes within the semiconductor, display, and solar energy sectors. The company officially changed its name from Wonik IPS Co., Ltd. to Wonik Holdings Co., Ltd. in May 2016.
